title: Tivona – Chrome New Tab Dashboard & Daily Planner
description: Plan your day in every Chrome new tab. Tivona brings together website shortcuts, a to-do list, a calendar with Persian dates, and a Pomodoro timer.
shareDescription: Open a Chrome tab to find your site shortcuts, today’s tasks, calendar, and Pomodoro timer.
headline: Tivona, a new tab dashboard for Chrome
intro: Open a tab to reach your favorite websites, see what’s due today, and start a focus session. Tivona puts your shortcuts, to-do list, and calendar on the same page.
installNote: Free for desktop Chrome. Tivona replaces your new tab page and works without a Tivona account.

dashboard.alt: Tivona’s Chrome dashboard with shortcut tiles and folders, a monthly calendar, a to-do list, and a weather forecast
dashboard.caption: Example dashboard with the optional course tracker enabled.

featuresTitle: Shortcuts and tools for planning your day
features: Use Speed Dial to pin your most visited sites, group them into folders, and find them with the keyboard. You can also import a folder from Chrome Bookmarks.
Add tasks with due dates, priorities, notes, and checklist steps. See what’s due today or overdue, and pick a day on the calendar to see the tasks scheduled for it.
Use the calendar widget to switch between Shamsi (Jalali), Gregorian, and Hijri dates. Show more than one calendar together and see Iranian holidays in the Shamsi view.
Set your own focus and break lengths or use the stopwatch. Start a focus session from a task and record the time you spent on it.

calendars.alt: A selected day in Tivona’s calendar showing its Gregorian, Shamsi, and Hijri dates and an option to add a task
calendars.caption: Select a day to see its dates across calendars and add a task for that day.

more: Choose which widgets to show. You can check the weather, count down to a date, track habits or goals, follow course progress, or keep a journal.
startTitle: Get started with your first tab
steps: Install Tivona from the Chrome Web Store and open a new tab.
Add a favorite website to Speed Dial or add a task with a due date.
Choose your language, calendar, and visible widgets in Settings.
faq: Can I bring over my Chrome bookmarks?
In Speed Dial, choose Import from Chrome Bookmarks. Tivona asks for permission and copies the folder you select.
What if I already use a new tab extension?
Chrome lets one extension control the new tab page at a time. You can manage which extensions are enabled from Chrome’s Extensions page.
How do I move my tasks to another computer?
In Settings → Data, export a backup and restore that file in Tivona on the other computer. Your tasks are part of the backup.
offline: The core tools, including your calendar, tasks, journal, and timer, work offline. Opening websites and fetching weather or online shortcut icons use an internet connection.
privacy: Your tasks, journal, and focus history are stored on this device. Some settings and shortcuts can use Chrome Sync if you have it enabled. Builds configured for PostHog offer optional usage sharing that starts off.
